title: Joint Petition of Hub Bus Lines, Inc. and Sabrina Coach Lines, Inc., requesting that the Department of Public Utilities approve the assignment and transfer, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7A, of charter license No. 17276 and that the Department remove the restriction on the charter license limiting the charter service to trips originating in the City of Boston, pursuant to G.L. c. 159, § 11A.
